title: The Broken Tone: How Finnic Neighbors Shaped the Latvian Sound...
text: Latvian is a pitch-accent language, meaning the way you pitch your voice on a syllable can change the meaning or grammar of a word. Standard Latvian distinguishes three syllable intonations: The Level Tone (stieptā): A steady, singing tone. The Falling Tone (krītošā): The pitch drops sharply.
